What it means: At the October 22, 2026 hearing [00:18], the board approved conditional use zoning for a cafe at 10 to 18 Bowden Street [05:03, 08:15], a two-family residential conversion at 21 Street [09:03, 13:01], legalizing an existing shed and bobcat storage alongside a curb cut at 18 Baker Avenue [13:46, 15:12], an attic dormer and mudroom addition at 68 Theodore Parker Road [15:41, 16:44], a driveway curb widening at 11 Alter Crest Road [17:11, 24:56], finishing a basement at 294 Stratford Street [25:55, 28:08], and a sunroom addition at 75 Oakland Street [29:32, 33:01]. The case for 85 Champ Street was postponed due to attorney illness [03:41, 03:52].

Who moved it: Mr. Stebridge moved to postpone the 85 Champ Street case, and Barza seconded it [03:56, 04:05]. Norm moved to approve the 11 Alter Crest Road case [24:10, 24:44]. For the other approved items, the transcript records board members putting forward and seconding motions of approval without specifying every speaker's full name [08:04, 12:49, 14:52, 16:32, 27:56, 32:47]. Votes of approval were recorded across the cases from Mr. Stebridge, Miss Better Braza, and the Chair [04:09, 08:11, 12:57, 15:08, 16:40, 24:52, 28:03, 32:56].

What to watch: The postponed case for 85 Champ Street will be taken up on November 17th at 9:30 a.m. [03:52]. The approval for 18 Baker Avenue carries a condition requiring BPD design review to examine property screening [14:54]. The board adjourned the session until November [33:08].

summary: During the October 22, 2026, City of Boston Zoning Board of Appeal hearing [00:18], the board voted to defer the case for 85 Champ Street to November 17, 2026 [03:48]-[04:13]. The board then approved conditional use relief to convert a retail space into a cafe at 10 to 18 Bowden Street [05:03]-[08:15], an addition and conversion of a single-family home to a two-family dwelling at 21 Street [08:58]-[13:01], relief for an existing shed and a curb cut at 18 Baker Avenue with design review for screening [13:46]-[15:12], an attic dormer and mudroom addition at 68 Theodore Parker Road [15:40]-[16:44], a curb cut widening at 11 Alter Crest Road [17:11]-[24:56], a basement finishing project at 294 Stratford Street [25:55]-[28:08], and front and side yard setback relief for a sunroom addition at 75 Oakland Street [29:32]-[33:01].
